character: Åre is Sweden's largest ski resort, on the Åreskutan mountain in Jämtland, run by SkiStar across three linked areas: Åre By, Åre Björnen and Duved/Tegefjäll. It has about 100 km of pistes, around 90 runs and 47 lifts, including an aerial tramway to about 1,274 m and the historic Bergbanan funicular from the village.
